name: Chicken Bacon Ranch Cauliflower Bake
note: Crustless low-carb cauliflower cheese bake (13g carbs) - a strong fit for a low-carb run. Cross-lane + catalog dedup: nearest flavor-family analog is slow-cooker-crack-chicken-bowls (chicken+bacon+cream-cheese+cheddar), but that is a potato-loaded slow-cooker BOWL - different starch (russet potatoes vs none) and different method (slow cooker vs oven bake), a distinct plate. chicken-bacon-ranch-burrito is a tortilla burrito; chicken-divan-broccoli-bake and turkey-divan-broccoli-rice-bake are broccoli/divan (no ranch, no bacon); hunters-chicken and loaded-chicken-and-potato-casserole are BBQ / potato bakes. No twin in accepted-slugs (only creamy-tuscan-chicken-skillet). Zero unmapped ingredients, full Omaha board coverage. POOL WATCH: candidates/low-carb-chicken-bacon-broccoli-cauliflower-bake is a likely near-duplicate of THIS dish (chicken+bacon+ranch+cauliflower bake, plus broccoli) - reject it against this acceptance when it reaches decision. Cross-protein WATCH: a turkey or pork bacon-ranch-cauliflower cheese bake would be the same dinner under another protein.
